title: Structural basis of T-loop–independent recognition and activation of CDKs by the CDK-activating kinase | Science
content: Cyclin-dependent kinases (CDKs) are prototypical regulators of the cell cycle. The CDK-activating kinase (CAK) acts as a master regulator of CDK activity by catalyzing the activating phosphorylation of CDKs on a conserved threonine residue within the ...
